purpose: Document authoritative discovery paths for a future licensed public-scene benchmark without downloading or committing remote imagery.

providers.access_note: Discovery is public; asset access conditions and registration requirements must be checked by the person explicitly opting in.
USGS describes Landsat data as public domain and requests source acknowledgement; cloud-provider charges or credentials may still apply.

required_user_selection: red, NIR, quality-mask, CRS, affine transform, and timestamp assets
required_local_record: upstream item metadata and asset URLs
cloud, shadow, saturation, and nodata decoding
reprojection, resampling, co-registration, and compositing decisions
reference-label license, creator, method, and spatial split
adapter_contract.repository_policy: Downloaded raster assets and credentials stay untracked; only reviewed manifests, hashes, derived aggregate evidence, and licensing notes may be proposed separately.
